data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase AI Logic SDK to access Gemini, Imagen and other generative models.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart APIs to call Firebase AI services such as text generation and image generation. Handles authentication, App Check and integrates with Firebase core packages.
use_when: You need Firebase‑hosted generative AI models like Gemini or Imagen
Your app already uses other Firebase services (auth, core, app‑check)
You prefer a managed backend over self‑hosting LLMs
avoid_when: You want a completely offline/on‑device model
You need a non‑Firebase AI provider or custom model serving
strengths: Automatic handling of auth and App Check tokens
weaknesses: Limited to Firebase AI services only
Requires Firebase project configuration and internet access
Plugin adds native setup for each platform
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core, firebase_auth, firebase_app_check to your project and configure each platform (Android manifest, iOS plist, web initialization). No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: openai_dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using OpenAI models directly without Firebase dependencies
